# AI Mode 推出预订、个性化与协作功能

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2025-08-25 14:07（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/1959860070377726392
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

1. @rajanpatel 分享 AI Mode 的最新功能：预订、个性化搜索、协作式链接分享，以及在 180+ 个国家开放：
https://x.com/rajanpatel/status/1958559750368776650

### 原帖中的引用预览（非被引用文章全文）

[Rajan Patel @rajanpatel](<https://x.com/rajanpatel/status/1958559750368776650>)

搜索中的 AI Mode 今天迎来令人兴奋的更新！

1️⃣ AI Mode 更像智能体了：借助 Project Mariner 的实时网页浏览能力预订餐厅。（活动门票与本地服务预约也即将推出。）

2️⃣ AI Mode 更贴合个人需求了：根据你的个人偏好与兴趣、之前的对话，以及你在搜索和地图中搜索或点击过的地点，提供结果。

3️⃣ AI Mode 更方便协作了：把 AI Mode 中激发你灵感的内容链接分享给联系人，这样你们就能一起继续搜索和探索。

哦，我们提过了吗？AI Mode 现在已在新增的 180+ 个国家和地区提供英语服务！

## 英文原文

1. @rajanpatel shares AI mode’s latest features: book reservations, personalized search, collaborative link sharing and availability to 180+ countries:
https://x.com/rajanpatel/status/1958559750368776650

### Quoted preview

[Rajan Patel @rajanpatel](<https://x.com/rajanpatel/status/1958559750368776650>)

Exciting updates landing today for AI Mode in Search!

1️⃣AI Mode gets more agentic: make restaurant reservations with live web-browsing capabilities from Project Mariner (also coming soon for event tickets & local appointments)

2️⃣AI Mode gets more tailored: get results based on your personal preferences & interests, previous conversations, and the places you’ve searched or tapped in Search & Maps.

3️⃣AI Mode gets more collaborative: share links to what you’re inspired by in AI Mode with your contacts, so you can continue searching & exploring together

Oh, and did we mention? AI Mode is now available in English in 180+ new countries and territories!
